title: Answerlattice Authority Transfer
dataPolicy: Synthetic demo data only. No real customer, tenant, ticket, review, or private business data.
renderPolicy: Local HyperFrames plus FFmpeg. No cloud video renderer required.

shots.beat: Incoming questions enter as unresolved support demand.
Review steps map each question to a product surface and approved wording.
Reviewed answers become hosted help and widget-safe support knowledge.
The loop ends with governance state, version, and citation visible.
